name: Archivist
resourceDesc: Mana pays for every song and spell; one song (Cadence or Dirge) can be sung at a time.
identity: A song-caster of the Silent Pilgrims: the purest crowd control, and as the Unwriting a slow grey death, as the Still Vow wards and atonement. Lull a pull to sleep, bind the worst of it, hush the casters. (GAME-ONLY kit on CANON roots: the Original Song, the echo-jars.)

branches.name: The Still Vow
branches.loop: Lay a Vow of Stillness on whoever is about to be hit, keep Shard Note going so its Atonement mends the party, and ward two at once when the blow everyone sees coming lands.
branches.tradeoff: The Still Vow heals through wards and through the notes you hit with: stop singing at the foe and the mending stops too.
branches.canon: CANON-EXPANDED (Chris, 2026-10-12: a Discipline-like support); reworked from the Silent Vow. The Silent Pilgrims' silence as wards. No machines.

nodes.name: Vow of Stillness
nodes.desc: New action: Vow of Stillness: a ward of silence on the most hurt within 30m for 10s.

nodes.name: Thick Silence
nodes.desc: Vow of Stillness wards 8% more per rank.

nodes.name: Grace
nodes.desc: Vow of Stillness also mends 4% of maximum health per rank.

nodes.name: Atonement
nodes.desc: A Shard Note that lands mends the most hurt for 15% of its damage per rank.

nodes.name: Quiet Ward
nodes.desc: Vow of Stillness comes back 1s sooner per rank.

nodes.name: Hushed Pain
nodes.desc: Whoever bears your Vow of Stillness takes 3% less per rank while it lasts.

nodes.name: Second Ward
nodes.desc: Vow of Stillness also wards the next most hurt at half its worth.

nodes.name: Steady Voice
nodes.desc: Shard Note is sung 0.15s quicker per rank.

nodes.name: The Vow Kept
nodes.desc: Atonement mends everyone of your party within 10m of you, not the most hurt alone.

branches.name: The Lull
branches.loop: Lull the pull before it starts; keep the sleepers asleep; Unsong the one that wakes.
branches.tradeoff: The longest holds, and nothing else.

nodes.name: Deep Sleep
nodes.desc: Lull lasts 2 seconds longer per rank.

nodes.name: Unsong
nodes.desc: A mob woken from Lull or Echo Bind by damage is slowed by half for 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Soft Voice
nodes.desc: Lull's cooldown is 5 seconds shorter per rank.

nodes.name: Wide Lull
nodes.desc: Lull reaches 1 metre further around the target per rank.

nodes.name: A Fourth Sleeper
nodes.desc: Lull takes up to four mobs.

nodes.name: Dreams
nodes.desc: Lull costs 5 less Mana per rank.

nodes.name: Mesmer
nodes.desc: Echo Bind on a boss stuns it for 4 seconds instead of failing.

branches.name: The Unwriting
branches.loop: Unwrite every foe worth the Mana, let the grey eat them while you Shard Note, and Erasure what is already unwritten; the Hollow Echo of it mends the party.
branches.tradeoff: The Unwriting is slow to bite: a fight that ends in ten seconds ends before the grey has done its work.
branches.canon: CANON-EXPANDED (Chris, 2026-10-12: a shadow-priest-like damage-over-time build); reworked from the Archive. The Wasting's unmaking is the books'; the Archivist's use of it is the game's. No machines.

nodes.name: Unwrite
nodes.desc: New action: Unwrite: the target sung out of the record, a little every 2s for 12s.

nodes.name: Deep Unwriting
nodes.desc: Unwrite strikes 5% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Long Silence
nodes.desc: Unwrite strikes once more per rank.

nodes.name: Erasure
nodes.desc: New action: Erasure: a hard note that strikes out what is written; half again on an unwritten foe.

nodes.name: Hollow Echo
nodes.desc: Each strike of Unwrite mends the most hurt of your party for 10% of it per rank.

nodes.name: Grey Note
nodes.desc: Shard Note strikes an unwritten foe 8% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Void Hum
nodes.desc: Unwrite costs 3 less Mana per rank.

nodes.name: Quick Erasure
nodes.desc: Erasure comes back 1.5s sooner per rank.

nodes.name: Spreading Grey
nodes.desc: When an unwritten foe dies, the nearest foe within 8m is unwritten in its place.

nodes.name: The Unwritten
nodes.desc: Erasure on an unwritten foe unwrites every foe within 6m of it.

branches.name: The Cantor
branches.loop: Sing the Song of Mending under the fight, a Mending Phrase on whoever falls behind, and the Chorus when the blow everyone sees coming lands.
branches.tradeoff: A Cantor's songs are its healing: singing the Song of Mending means no Cadence and no Dirge, and its holds wait while it mends.

nodes.name: Clear Voice
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase heals 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Breath
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase is sung 0.15s quicker per rank.

nodes.name: Held Note
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase leaves a held note: 1% of maximum health a second for 5s per rank.

nodes.name: Chorus of the Weave
nodes.desc: New action: Chorus of the Weave: every party member within 15m takes a barrier for 8s.

nodes.name: Long Song
nodes.desc: The Song of Mending mends 0.5% more of maximum health a second per rank.

nodes.name: Echoing Mend
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase on someone below 35% health heals 30% more.

nodes.name: Resonant Ward
nodes.desc: Chorus of the Weave's barriers are 25% larger per rank.

nodes.name: Quiet Mind
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase costs 3 less Mana per rank.

nodes.name: The Weave
nodes.desc: The Song of Mending reaches 2m further per rank.

nodes.name: Symphony of Mending
nodes.desc: Chorus of the Weave also heals each ally it shields for 8% of maximum health.

nodes.name: Second Voice
nodes.desc: Mending Phrase also heals the next most hurt for 30% of it per rank.

nodes.name: Desert of Echoes
nodes.desc: The Song of Mending can be sung beside Cadence or Dirge: two songs at once.

nodes.name: Last Verse
nodes.desc: An ally who would fall within your Song is left at 1 health instead, once every 60/45/30s.

nodes.name: Choir
nodes.desc: Chorus of the Weave's cooldown is halved.

nodes.name: The Mending Song
nodes.desc: Once a fight, sing the whole party back to full health.
